Use case: compositing / illustration-story. Asset type: final transparent illustrated image for the small 'Retornar ao Coreto' navigation button in a visual novel. Input 1 is the architectural reference: the existing clean octagonal wooden gazebo cutout. Input 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: Reed final.png. Create a NEW COLORED illustration combining both subjects. Preserve the gazebo's recognizable wide shingled roof, timber arches and posts, stone plinth and steps, bench, and lanterns. Color it with natural warm brown timber, muted brown roof shingles, warm gray stone and small amber lantern lights. Preserve Reed's identity EXACTLY from reference 2: elderly stocky dwarf, swept-back white hair, thick white brows, long abundant white beard with two narrow braided moustache strands with small golden clasps, broad friendly nose, black eyepatch on the same side as the reference (viewer RIGHT), red patterned sleeveless long coat with large angular collar, golden-yellow vest and white puffed sleeves. His visible eye and welcoming expression must match the reference. Keep his wooden tankard and inviting open hand. Composition: compact SQUARE icon illustration, gazebo recognizable behind Reed, roof fully visible; Reed as a LARGE waist-up foreground portrait in the lower-right half, overlapping the lower gazebo so his head and beard remain legible at a display size of about 116 pixels. His face must not be hidden by posts. Character and building form a single balanced cutout; do not make a tiny person lost inside the gazebo. Retain an intimate welcoming storytelling mood. Style: hand-drawn BLACK INK contours and fine hatching with textured colored-pencil/watercolor fills on the subjects, matching Reed's illustrated reference, not photorealism or 3D. Full color is explicitly required here, unlike the beige-only town. Transparent negative space around the combined subjects and through uncovered gazebo openings; no white or beige background rectangle. Allow a small transparent margin without excessive empty canvas. No oval, cameo, decorative frame, foliage border, city background, other characters, lettering, text, logo, watermark, UI button or baked shadow/halo. Actual transparent PNG alpha.
